description: Réseau Fibre Optique THD - Câbles - DGL Networks is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. The Very High Speed Network (THD) is a concession of the CU Dunkirk and constitutes a fibre optic backbone gilding the territory and allowing access points to public equipment. The cable layer allows the location of fiber optic sections between 2 connecting elements. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "THD Fiber Optic Network - Cables - DGL Networks" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include réseaux, fibre optique, infrastructures. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
